transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, hi. I guess I'm here because... I just can't seem to keep things organized. Like, my schoolwork and... I have this little accessories shop. It's just hard to manage both at the same time. 

My supplies, receipts, due dates, assignment notes... they all just end up in these piles everywhere. And then I just... I don't really know what to do first. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you have the same kind of trouble staying organized when you were a child?

Um... I don't really remember if it was about being organized, exactly. But... my mom still has some of the notes my elementary school teachers sent home. 

They mostly just complained that I was always out of my seat. Or... talking before they called on me. And they said I would rush through group activities, even when I actually understood the work. So... I guess school has just always been a little difficult.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to pay attention?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... if I'm in class, or watching a video for one of my business assignments... I can start out listening fine. But then... I don't know, after a few minutes, my mind just kind of goes to other things. Like charm designs... or ideas for shop orders. And then I just... realize I missed half of what was actually said. So... yeah.
Do these focus and organization problems happen in more than one part of your life, like both school and your shop?
Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean, it's mostly school and the shop. I don't really know about other things. But... yeah, both of those.
Have these problems caused you to miss deadlines or make mistakes often enough that they’ve created real trouble at school or with your shop?

Um... yeah. It's... it's caused some issues. Like, with school... I missed some of the required steps for my program. So now my financial aid is kind of... at risk. And... with the shop, the people I work with on projects have just... started depending on me less. So... yeah.
When you try to organize your schoolwork or shop materials, do you get stuck because you want it done in a very exact or perfect way?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really care if it's perfect. I just... I just have a hard time getting it organized in the first place.
When you’re trying to focus or get organized, do you usually feel worried or anxious first?
Um... no. Not really worried. Just... scattered, I guess. I don't really feel anxious about it beforehand.
